PREFIX brick: <http://brickschema.org/schema/1.2/brick#>
PREFIX ref: <http://example.com/ref#>
SELECT ?s ?id WHERE {
  ?s brick:hasPrimaryTag rdfs:label .
  ?s ref:hasTimeseriesId ?id .
  FILTER(str(?s) LIKE "%AHU03%")
}
